entry.title: Steam Client Beta - October 26th
entry.summary:
The Steam Client Beta has been updated with the following changes:
Steam Input
Added support for GameInput v4
Remote Play
Start streaming faster when connecting to a local computer
Fixed the "..." button on the Steam Controller not being passed through to the remote side
Linux
Fixed a crash when resuming from suspend
Big Picture Mode
Updated the styling of the chat tab to better convey focus states
Game invites from friends now have a dedicated widget in the chat window above the text entry, instead of having to navigate to the exact message in the chat history window. Individual invites from friends in a group also show in the group chat window instead of having to navigate to the individual friend's 1-1 chat tab to accept.
Improved the group chat layout and fixed areas where gamepad navigation could get stuck
Friend chat message notifications will now be rolled up rather than sending one 2 second notification per message
Plumbed the per-friend voice chat levels to the friend context menu in BPM

entry.title: Steam Beta Client Update: October 15th
entry.summary:
We have just shipped an updated Steam Client to the Preview/Beta channel.
Steam Achievement Sets A new way to organize, track, and complete a game's achievements. Read more details in the announcement.
Games can now organize and group achievements for base game and DLC content
DLC achievements can be added via sets without breaking game completion
Completed achievement sets remain completed when new sets are added
Achievements and sets can be archived if they are seasonal or can no longer be achieved
Updated Achievements page and achievement rollup displays
General
Notifications settings layout has been changed to be easier to work with on all screen sizes
Fixed multiple edge cases that could cause memory leaks in game streaming and controller code
Multiple general stability improvements and fixes for rare crashes affecting small numbers of users
Fixed an error displaying dates for users in British Columbia
Library
Improved offline support for the activity feed and fixed cases where it could previously skip loading some events.
Linux
The Steam client is now a 64bit application.
The Steam client now runs inside a Steam Runtime container.
This will help the Steam client provide a more consistent experience across multiple distributions. This is the same technology used by Steam games.
Fixed a case where Steam updater UI would fail to show for some users.
Remote Play
Added a "Display Style" setting to allow stretching and zooming when the stream is a different aspect ratio than the client display.
Steam Controller Firmware
Fixed an issue where shutting down a controller while docked to the puck could cause it to turn back on
Accessibility
Background art will appear on the home screen when High Contrast is enabled

OS:

entry.title: Steam Client Update For Frame: October 6th
entry.summary:
Steam Client (for Steam Frame) has just been released for all users with the following changes:
Steam Frame
Settings shows the user-visible serial number instead of the SOC serial.
Guided Tour now shows for any new account logging into the device, not just the first

Fix some cases of header/footer flicker and invisibility during the first seconds after waking from sleep.
When waking from sleep with a game running but the account now playing elsewhere:
Provide an option to exit the local game.
Go back to sleep if there is no input for 60 seconds.

Fixed a clicking the back button in the footer not working if nothing on the page had digital navigation focus

Fix "Suspend Download Throttle" not properly updating on the downloads page.
Fixed regression causing crash in native Linux version of some games.
Remote Play
Improved color accuracy when streaming an OpenGL game.

entry.title: SteamOS 0.4.3 Beta for Steam Frame
entry.summary:
SteamOS 0.4.3 (for Steam Frame) has just been released.
This update is for the Steam Frame Beta channel, and includes new features that are still being tested. You can opt into this in Settings > System > System Update Channel.
General
Improved power efficiency and battery lifetime during both streaming and local gameplay, with gains of up to 12%. Note: Result vary depending on framerate and content.
Added accessibility option for users who want to limit eye tracking to a single eye. VR Settings -> General -> Track Dominant Eye Only. (requires enabling "show advanced settings")
Fixed an issue that prevented controller bindings from loading for certain games, including Google Earth VR and Thumper.
Improved focus behavior when interacting with grab/resize handles
Streaming:
Further VR streaming reliability improvements, including additional fixes for “Error 17.” Note: On the PC, you must also opt into SteamVR 2.18.2 or later to reduce “Error 17” connection issues. At the time of this release, SteamVR 2.18.2 is available on the SteamVR \[beta] branch.
Fixed steam frame wireless adapter connectivity issues that affected users in some countries.
This OS release includes SteamVR (2.18.2)
